services.name: ⛵ Two-Hour Private Catamaran Charter
services.desc: 🌞 A Classic Waikīkī Escape Looking for something short and sweet? This two-hour charter gives you the perfect taste of sailing paradise — ideal for groups on a tighter schedule, families with keiki, or anyone who just wants to cruise, relax, and take in the views. Sail past Diamond Head, sip your favorite drink, and watch the city fade behind you as we head out into calm Hawaiian waters. It's simple, seamless, and completely private. 💵 Private Sail (Ages 5+, Up to 30 guests): $1,500 Includes exclusive use of the catamaran, crew, snorkel gear, soft drinks, and coolers. ✨ Highlights 1,500 per Private Sail · World-famous!

services.name: ⛵ Three-Hour Private Catamaran Charter
services.desc: 🌺 Your Sail, Your Way Sail along the world-famous shores of Waikīkī on your own private catamaran. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, hosting a team retreat, or just gathering friends and family, this three-hour charter is fully customizable to fit your group’s vibe. Cruise past Diamond Head, swim in crystal-clear waters, or relax with a drink as the sun begins to set — it's your call. 💵 Private Sail (Ages 5+, Up to 30 guests): $2,250 Includes exclusive use of the vessel, crew, snorkel gear, ice, coolers, and music. ✨ Highlights Private use of our 52' classic Hawaiian catamaran $2,250 per Private Sail · Waikiki Beach
